title: Generator initialization decides the complement
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input symbols, let $L$ be a language of Boolean words, let $sp:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. Suppose $N$ decides $L$ using space at most $sp(n)$ on inputs of length $n$. For natural numbers $E$ and $B$, suppose the code bound of $N$ is at most $E$, $1\le E$, and $2^{2E(\operatorname{size}(|x|)+1)+2E(sp(|x|)+1)}+1\le B$. Then, starting the generator in its scanning state with all registers zero, every computation branch terminates, every register stays at most $B$ before halting, and some branch accepts if and only if $x\notin L$.
